raw_text:
PLAN "Travel Maintenance 2-Week Bodyweight & Doorbar"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintenance hypertrophy & strength in hotel room"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Upper Body Maintenance":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45 seconds rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Tuesday training 25m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday rest
      DAY Thursday training 28m "Pull Focus & Core":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          inverted_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 70 seconds
          dumbbell_row* (use water bottle if no dumbbells) 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicycle_crunch 3x20 reps each side
        cooldown:
          side_plank 2x30 seconds each side
      DAY Friday training 26m "Push & Mobility":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dips (using door frame) 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press (if no weight, incline push_ups) 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension (band or towel substitute) 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Saturday active_recovery 20m "Mobility & Light Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walking_lunge 3x12 each leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Sunday rest
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 32m "Upper Body Maintenance B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Tuesday training 28m "Lower Body & Core B":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday rest
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Pull & Core A":
        warmup:
          high_knees 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          russian_twist 3x20 reps
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 28m "Push & Mobility B":
        warmup:
          shoulder_circles 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press (or floor_pressed) 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown (towel) 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Saturday active_recovery 20m "Mobility & Light Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 3x12 each leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Sunday rest

Notes:
- Use only: push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, lat_pulldown (if available; else substitute with pull_up/chin_up), cable_row (if no cables, use dumbbell_row), seated_row (sub with bent_over_row if needed), inverted_row, goblet_squat, squat, hip_thrust, hanging_leg_raise, plank, hollow_hold, bicycle_crunch, russian_twist, step_up, calf_raise, ankle_circles, hip_flexor_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, lat_stretch, hamstring_stretch.
- Cardio: walking, jogging in place, rowing, running, jump_rope, cycling, etc. Adjust to hotel room constraints; no running in place if impact concerns—use low-impact options.
- If equipment is unavailable (e.g., dumbbells), substitute with bodyweight variations or use filled water bottles as resistance where appropriate.
- RPE guidance: 7 for work sets where aiming to preserve volume; 8 on the heavier pulling sets when possible given travel constraints.
- Rest intervals as indicated; adjust to 60–90 seconds depending on capacity while maintaining form.
- Ensure a gentle cool-down and mobility finish to support recovery and travel schedule.

goals.name: Maintenance hypertrophy & strength in hotel room
